title: Absolutely perfect day trip!  Viators tours have all been perfect!
text: Tarragona was a beautiful town.  We loved how they incorporated the ancient buildings into the current structures.  It would be wonderful to spend more days there.  Sitges was the perfect  way to end the day.  Lovely time on the beautiful beach. I believe the guide was Rodrigo, and he was so knowledgeable and helpful.
author: Christine_S

title: great day out with Xavier
text: wonderful tour guided by the informative and cheerful Xavier. our first time in Barcelona to celebrate my beloved's birthday. highly recommend this laidback and historic day out to see some marvelous sites and great history. cannot say enough about the tour and our dear guide Xavier!!
author: Cf c

title: Best part of our Catalonia trip!!
text:
Enrique did a wonderful job as our tour guide. He answered questions about many things regarding our tour and the Catalonia area as a whole.
He gave a great restaurant recommendation for Sitges and for Barcelona which we ate at after our tour and it was wonderful!
Tarragona has a wonderfully preserved Roman aqueduct and the other Roman architecture was quite fun to see.
We had plenty of free time and he was quite flexible to meet our desires.

author: afton_d

title: Excellent experience with a very knowledgeable guide
text: We were picked up at  the hotel by our guide Enrique. Everything was well planned and Enrique proved to be a highly educated person, with  wide ranging knowledge in many fields, including of course local and Spanish history.  I would recommend this without hesitation to anyone
author: rodolfof299

title: Great tour with Arnau; really loved the Roman Aqueduct
text: Our favorite tour of many on our 9 day Spain trip.  We really did not expect to like this tour as much as we did given the fairly limited description provided.  Our guide (Arnau) was wonderful, very well prepared and very knowledgeable.  The Roman aqueduct was incredible and we really loved the experience of walking on it.  Terragona was also interesting and unique.  Sitges was interesting as well, but it was a holiday and completely packed/very crowded, which took away from our experience.  It would also have been better if a lunch reservation was made for us well in advance, as Arnau had to
author: Boris_N

title: Roman remains and coastline!
text: Awesome day exploring a Roman wall with nobody else around but our tour guide jordi. He was great, he took pictures and filled us with information. We visited an ancient amphitheater and old Catalunia!  He recommended  a place to eat lunch near the beach, and had plenty of time to go walk around on our own. A beautiful coastline in Sitges!
author: Lori_S

title: Absolutely wonderful!! Our private...
text: Absolutely wonderful!! Our private 4-person tour started with a detailed history of Barcelona on our way out of the city. Our guide was FANTASTIC and took the opportunity to give us an overview of the major sites we saw along the drive to Tarragona. Once in Tarragona, we visited the Roman Aquaduct - fascinating! Then there was a walking tour of the city with free time to explore afterwards.So many ruins and historical places to see - we were intriqued by them all. title: Really glad we took the tour since we...
text: Really glad we took the tour since we had only 2 days to go around Barcelona. This took a day off but was worth it. The representative from the Sitges Office of Tourism took us on a walking tour and he switched from Spanish to English without any effort. That was amazing!
